title: Development Order Addendum v2 — Wave insertions for AF-40..AF-51 (FR-27..FR-37)
sequence_rules_inherited: Topological: dep AF in earlier or same wave (verified by self-check against the AF graph)
SERIES execution: wave N fully green before wave N+1 starts
Per-wave gate: wave's pytest subset GREEN + store gates green locally; no remote tier configured (TC-84 is the one owner-manual REMOTE check — print preview/physical print, per Test_Plan_addendum_v2)
Error surfacing (AF-30) and schema decoupling (AF-29) are foundational: no code ships that swallows errors or keys off header text/position

test_gate_map.TC-82: Add Position tenure auto-calculates from exact date range with no manual tenure field
test_gate_map.TC-83: Credit day validated to 1-28 and legacy import maps start month/tenure to exact dates with default credit day

wave_insertions.rationale: AF-50 is the pure date/tenure/credit-day validator feeding the upgraded add form and the legacy import path; its only dep AF-02 (xlsx_reader, W0) is strictly earlier. Lands in W1 so the import pipeline (W1) can already apply the legacy date mapping and so every downstream wave (notably W2's day-wise sweep consuming credit_day) finds validated dates in place. The two date/tenure TCs (Test_Plan_addendum_v2 titles: TC-82 tenure auto-calc, TC-83 credit-day validation + legacy mapping) gate W1 with AF-50.

test_gate_map.TC-78: Credit-day-5 unpaid on day-6 flips to Danger same day; paid month stays On-going; Completed unchanged

wave_insertions.rationale: AF-46 joins the status-engine wave: its deps AF-14 and AF-15 are both W2 (same-wave allowed), and credit_day is validated by AF-50 in W1. The sweep must exist before the W4 grid re-sort, notification builder and email sender consume its results. The day-wise sweep TC (Test_Plan_addendum_v2 title: TC-78, covering same-day flip, paid-stays and D5-Completed-preservation in one unit case) gates W2 with AF-46.

test_gate_map.TC-76: Charts trio renders as inline SVG with ZERO network requests to any external host
test_gate_map.TC-77: Status donut reflects the Danger/On-going/Completed split from live position data
test_gate_map.TC-81: Monthly history stops at current month and auto-appends each new month from the ledger

wave_insertions.rationale: Both AFs extend the dashboard-query wave. AF-45's deps AF-10/AF-13/AF-14 are all W2; AF-49's dep AF-20 is same-wave W3. AF-45 supplies the data queries the dashboard charts consume (inline-SVG rendering is template-side); AF-49 windows AF-20's history aggregation. Gates: charts TCs (Test_Plan_addendum_v2 titles: TC-76 trio+offline+negative-red, TC-77 donut split) with AF-45 and history TC (TC-81 window+auto-append) with AF-49.

test_gate_map.TC-67: Blocked-at-form add leaves grid, dashboard and watch list empty of the blocked position
test_gate_map.TC-68: No alternate add route: grid and dashboard expose no add-position control
test_gate_map.TC-74: Privacy Mode masks every monetary value across all surfaces and persists across reload
test_gate_map.TC-75: Grid auto-sorts Danger, On-going, Completed and re-sorts automatically on status change
test_gate_map.TC-79: Every alert fires both channels (in-app bell + Gmail SMTP email) and lands in the alert history
test_gate_map.TC-80: Alert history is auditable and no SMS/WhatsApp/push channel is shipped

wave_insertions.rationale: The user-visible UI/alert slice joins the grid-and-launch wave. AF-40 deps AF-38 (W4 same-wave) and AF-39 (W2, earlier); AF-43 deps AF-01 (W0); AF-44 deps AF-14 (W2); AF-47 deps AF-46 (W2 via this addendum); AF-48 deps AF-47 (W4 same-wave — builder rows exist before the sender consumes them; the pair stays in one wave, ordered within the wave). Gates (Test_Plan_addendum_v2 titles): entry TCs TC-67 (blocked add leaves no trace) + TC-68 (no alternate add route) with AF-40; privacy TC TC-74 (global mask + persistence) with AF-43; sort TC TC-75 (auto-sort + re-sort) with AF-44; notification/email TCs TC-79 (dual-channel cadence) + TC-80 (auditable history, no SMS/push) with AF-47/AF-48 — TC-79 exercises both the bell rows (AF-47) and the SMTP sends (AF-48); TC-80 gates the retained history and the no-other-channels constraint across the pair.

test_gate_map.TC-72: Share panel section checkboxes exclude non-selected sections; amounts visibility toggles amounts
test_gate_map.TC-73: Share snapshot respects Privacy Mode: HTML and CSV both mask every amount
test_gate_map.TC-84: Monthly Print renders A4 five-section layout and is privacy-aware (owner-manual print review)

wave_insertions.rationale: Export/view wave extensions. AF-42 deps AF-26 (W5 same-wave exporter conventions) and AF-43 (W4, earlier — privacy state must exist); AF-51 deps AF-43 (W4). Both are consumer surfaces of the W4 privacy gate and sit after the CSV exporter wave so exporter quoting/encoding conventions are already green. Gates (Test_Plan_addendum_v2 titles): share TCs TC-72 (section checkboxes + amounts visibility) + TC-73 (privacy-masked HTML+CSV) with AF-42; print TC TC-84 (A4 five-section, privacy-aware) with AF-51 — TC-84 is the suite's single REMOTE/owner-manual case (print pagination verified in a real browser print preview), matching SRS FR-37 check_method 'manual review'.

test_gate_map.TC-69: Goals renamed Financial Goals: tab label and heading renamed, 'Home Plan' string gone
test_gate_map.TC-70: Goal accepts target amount and target end date for a 10-year plan
test_gate_map.TC-71: Legacy irregular savings rows (25000/10000/0) import as goals, not bonds

wave_insertions.rationale: AF-41 lands with the Phase-3 features wave (legacy home-plan view AF-31 already exists there as route_handlers precedent); its only dep AF-01 (W0) is strictly earlier, and placing it in W6 lets the imported legacy schedule (W1 commit) and privacy masking (W4) both be in place before the goals surface ships. Gates: goals TCs (Test_Plan_addendum_v2 titles: TC-69 rename, TC-70 target fields, TC-71 legacy import as goals) with AF-41.

topology_note: TOPOT check against v1 + addendum v1 wave assignments, every edge stated explicitly. AF-50 (W1): dep AF-02 is W0 -> W0 < W1. AF-46 (W2): deps AF-14 and AF-15 are both W2 -> same-wave W2 = W2 (allowed by the earlier-or-same rule). AF-45 (W3): deps AF-10, AF-13, AF-14 are all W2 -> W2 < W3 each. AF-49 (W3): dep AF-20 is W3 -> same-wave W3 = W3. AF-40 (W4): dep AF-38 is W4 (addendum v1) -> same-wave W4 = W4; dep AF-39 is W2 (addendum v1) -> W2 < W4. AF-43 (W4): dep AF-01 is W0 -> W0 < W4. AF-44 (W4): dep AF-14 is W2 -> W2 < W4. AF-47 (W4): dep AF-46 is W2 (this addendum) -> W2 < W4. AF-48 (W4): dep AF-47 is W4 (this addendum) -> same-wave W4 = W4, so AF-47 is implemented and green within W4 before AF-48's send path calls it (intra-wave order: builder before sender). AF-42 (W5): dep AF-26 is W5 -> same-wave W5 = W5 (csv_exporter conventions already in the wave's base AF list); dep AF-43 is W4 (this addendum) -> W4 < W5. AF-51 (W5): dep AF-43 is W4 -> W4 < W5. AF-41 (W6): dep AF-01 is W0 -> W0 < W6. Cross-wave ordering also holds: the day-wise sweep (W2) lands before its W4 consumers (AF-47 notifications, AF-44 re-sort); privacy (W4) lands before its W5 consumers (AF-42 share, AF-51 print). No cross-wave back-edge is introduced; every v1 and addendum-v1 AF->wave assignment and test gate is unchanged.
change_record: addendum v2.0 extends Development_Order_addendum_v1 after owner decisions D16-D26 (2026-10-30); inserts AF-50 into W1, AF-46 into W2, AF-45+AF-49 into W3, AF-40+AF-43+AF-44+AF-47+AF-48 into W4, AF-42+AF-51 into W5, AF-41 into W6 — no change to any existing wave's AF list or TC gates. TC-67..TC-84 come from docs/Test_Plan_addendum_v2.json, which appeared during self-check (parallel worker); titles in test_gate_map are aligned to that document verbatim and the scenario split is: date/tenure TCs (TC-82 tenure auto-calc, TC-83 credit-day validation + legacy mapping) gate W1 with AF-50; day-wise sweep TC (TC-78) gates W2 with AF-46; charts + history TCs (TC-76 charts trio offline, TC-77 donut split, TC-81 history window) gate W3 with AF-45/AF-49; entry/privacy/sort/notification/email TCs (TC-67+TC-68 entry, TC-74 privacy, TC-75 sort, TC-79+TC-80 alerts) gate W4 with AF-40/AF-43/AF-44/AF-47/AF-48; share + print TCs (TC-72+TC-73 share, TC-84 print — the suite's single REMOTE owner-manual case) gate W5 with AF-42/AF-51; goals TCs (TC-69 rename, TC-70 target fields, TC-71 legacy import) gate W6 with AF-41. All 18 TCs placed exactly once, disjoint, range TC-67..TC-84.
